text: dsh-review-gate 为 DSH Web 提供独立审查：按真实用户消息间隔提醒主模型复核科研成品，并用 review_gate_check 将代码、推导或文件路径交给审查子代理。请求可附重点和文本，超长内容按配置截断；审查结果及修复要求返回对话。设置页管理提醒、审查者和日志，输入栏提供快捷开关。B 提示目前只随审查工具派发的子代理生效。

dsh-review-gate adds independent review to DSH Web. It reminds the model at a configurable cadence and offers review_gate_check to send code or derivations to a reviewer subagent. The tool returns verdicts and fixes. A settings page manages reviewer options. B reaches only reviewer subagents.
想让 DSH 把我写完的代码交给另一个 agent 独立检查。
数学推导完成后，能提醒模型再找子代理复核吗？
让审查者重点检查我指定的代码问题，并给出可执行的修复要求。
我想在 DSH Web 设置页调整审查者、提示词和送审长度。
Can I ask a separate agent to review a derivation and return concrete fixes?
Remind my DSH model to get research code checked by a reviewer after I finish it.
dsh-review-gate 的功能「周期审查提醒」：按真实用户消息计数，在首条消息及设定间隔到达时向主模型追加可编辑提示，子代理消息不触发。
dsh-review-gate 的功能「独立审查调用」：模型或用户调用 review_gate_check，提交文本或文件路径及可选重点，插件派发审查子代理并把裁决和修复要求返回对话。
dsh-review-gate 的功能「审查设置界面」：在 DSH Web 提供独立设置页、插件卡片和输入栏 A/B 快捷开关，可调整提醒、provider、白名单、送审限制和日志选项。
dsh-review-gate 的功能「运行状态查看」：设置界面读取 loopback 状态接口，显示可用 provider、提醒和送审计数以及最近一次审查裁决。
dsh-review-gate 使用前须知：B 提示只随 review_gate_check 派发的审查子代理生效，普通子代理不带该提示（见 src/index.ts:449-518）。
把科研代码交给另一个模型检查参数和边界问题。
I want a configurable reminder to request an independent review of research work.

@dsh-external/dsh-review-gate README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ttxs66666/dsh-review-gate
```

Restart `dsh web` afterwards. Requires DSH on the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` **0.1.x line, 0.1.5-rc.1 or newer** (`^0.1.5-rc.1 || ^0.1.6-rc.1` — the explicit prerelease branches are there because a range without one silently excludes every prerelease build; see `peerDependencies`).
@dsh-external/dsh-review-gate README · What you get：Three surfaces, all bound to the same settings namespace, so they can never disagree:

@dsh-external/dsh-review-gate README · What you get：| Surface | Slot | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| **Settings → Review Gate** | `settings.section` (id `review-gate`, order 60) | The full page: master switch, A/B toggles and texts, injection cadence, reviewer configuration (provider / persona / tool whitelist / artifact limit / logging / log path), composer-toggle visibility, in-process stats polled every 5s |
| Composer `＋` menu | `conversation.input.left` | A/B quick toggles, hidden by the page's `＋` switch |
| Settings → Plugins | `settings.plugin.item` (key `review-gate`) | Compact card: status, master switch, pointer to the page |

@dsh-external/dsh-review-gate README · What you get：> **Screenshots** (optional, for storefronts): drop `assets/screenshot-1.png` … into your repository and list them in `screenshots.json` next to `package.json` — `["assets/screenshot-1.png"]`, 1–8 entries, paths relative to that file.

@dsh-external/dsh-review-gate README · Settings：Namespace `review-gate` (`applies: live` — every change takes effect immediately, no restart).

| Group | Fields |
|---|---|
| A / B | `enabled` `injectA` `injectB` `promptA` `promptB` `promptAEvery` `showComposerToggles` |
| Reviewer | `provider` `reviewerPersona` `reviewerTools` `maxArtifactChars` `verboseLog` `logFile` |

@dsh-external/dsh-review-gate README · Settings：The reviewer group resolves as **schema defaults → this plugin's composition config (`base` layer) → user layer**: a value set in your profile config stays the effective default, the settings page overrides it, and clearing a field falls back to that config.

@dsh-external/dsh-review-gate README · Settings：Host route: `GET /review-gate/api/status` (loopback only, no auth) returns the resolved settings, the available subagent providers, B's real delivery surface, and the process counters. The page shows **host unreachable** when the route does not answer, and **host version is older** when it answers without the newer fields (i.e. the host half has not been restarted yet).

@dsh-external/dsh-review-gate README · Behaviour worth knowing：- **The tool whitelist is resolved against the calling agent's scope.** In a Web profile the tools live on an agent preset's standing scope rather than in the global layer, so a tool that exists can still be invisible to a global lookup. Names that are not visible are skipped with a log line; if the configured list is non-empty but *entirely* invisible, the review is **refused** instead of silently degrading into "no restriction". Dispatch itself retries with decreasing capability, so a whitelist the runtime rejects cannot fail the whole review.
- **Provider capabilities are gated before dispatch.** `persona`, `toolFilter` and `outputSchema` are only sent to providers declaring them; when `persona` is unsupported the role text is prepended to the prompt instead, and the verdict says so.
- **B's reach is reported, not assumed.** Kernels since 0.1.5-rc.1 removed `subagents.registerContinuableSetup`, so B currently reaches review subagents only; the status API reports `review-only` and the page renders that truth. If the API returns, the plugin goes back to `continuable+review` by itself.
- Counters live in process memory

@dsh-external/dsh-review-gate README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run check      # typecheck + build + smoke probes
npm run build      # host (tsc) → lib/index.js, client (tsdown) → lib/client.js
npm run probe      # zero-dependency smoke probes against the built artifacts

`lib/` **is committed on purpose**: DSH installs plugins from a git checkout without running a build, so the shipped bundle has to be in the repository. After changing `src/`, run `npm run build` and commit `lib/` together with it.

@dsh-external/dsh-review-gate README · Development：To develop against a local checkout instead, `npm run build:sh` links the peer dependencies out of an installed DSH (`DSH_CHECKOUT=<checkout> bash scripts/build.sh`) and then compiles both halves.

@dsh-external/dsh-review-gate README · Development：The probes under `test/` are plain node scripts. `probe-review-gate.mjs` drives the compiled host half through a fake context (whitelist resolution, config-error routing, capability downgrade, malformed verdicts, counters); `probe-client.mjs` renders the compiled client half through a miniature React with a fake `window`/`fetch` (all three surfaces, plus both host-status paths). `test/fixtures/quota-design.ts` is **not** part of the plugin — it is a deliberately flawed derivation kept around to exercise the gate itself.
